rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-bold uppercase
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-semibold uppercase

layout.grid_strategy: Control Room layout with immersive 3D background. The UI is split into a left column (panels), a central area (AI Orb + chat input), and a right column (panels).
layout.spacing: Dense but legible. Use Tailwind scale: p-2, p-4 for internal widget padding.
layout.border_radius: rounded-lg or rounded-xl (subtle, not too pill-shaped to maintain cyberpunk edge).

panels.style: Glassmorphism (Crystal variant). `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A1128]/60 border border-[#00F0FF]/30 shadow-[0_4px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]`
panels.header: macOS traffic light dots (red, yellow, green) on the top left, small title on the top right or center.

orb.description: Central glowing AI orb (Jarvis core). Made pure CSS/SVG. Pulse animation based on state (idle, listening, thinking).
orb.styles: Multiple concentric circles, drop-shadow, blur filters, rotating dashed SVG borders. Glow color should be primary (#00F0FF).

command_palette.description: Chat input at the bottom center. Glassmorphic, wide, with a microphone button.
command_palette.styles: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050B14]/80 border border-[#00F0FF]/50 rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-4

traffic_light_header.description: Header for each widget simulating a draggable OS window.
traffic_light_header.styles: flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 border-b border-[#00F0FF]/20 pb-2

animations.orb_pulse: Keyframes scaling from 0.95 to 1.05 and fading box-shadow intensity.
animations.panel_entrance: Staggered fade-in and slight translate-y on load.

icons.usage: Use for widget icons, command palette actions, window controls.

textures.grain: SVG noise filter applied to a fixed full-screen pseudo-element with opacity 0.05 - 0.1 and mix-blend-mode: overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page immersive AI dashboard.

Set the background image to cover the full viewport, overlaid with a very dark gradient (`bg-gradient-to-b from-[#050B14]/80 to-[#050B14]/95`) and a subtle grain texture to darken the image and create depth.
Use Chakra Petch for all headings and widget titles, IBM Plex Mono for data, code, and chat text.
Create 5-6 distinct draggable/floating style panels: Trading (mock charts/tickers), Twitter/X Feed, Calendar, Task Runner, Social Media.
Implement the central AI Orb using HTML/CSS/SVG (no WebGL required). Give it a 'listening'/'speaking' pulse animation.
Ensure all panels have the macOS traffic light buttons (red, yellow, green) in their headers.
Include a prominent voice-input enabled command palette at the bottom.
Use the colors specified (electric cyan, magenta, amber) strictly. Do not use generic tailwind blues/purples.
